findings.title: Amount Claimed differs from Total Payable and Pharmacy Bill
findings.detail: The amount claimed on the claim form does not equal the sum of the hospital total payable and the pharmacy bill.

findings.title: Investigation Charges billed without matching report in the file
findings.detail: The hospital bill includes investigation charges, but no investigation report is present in the file for these hospital-billed tests.

findings.title: Ward stay duration differs between hospital bill and discharge summary
findings.detail: The discharge summary states the patient was shifted to the ward on day 2 and remained there until discharge, which implies 2 ward days (11th and 12th), whereas the bill charges for 2 days of Semi-Private room rent in addition to ICU charges.

quotes.quote: Shifted to the ward on day 2 of admission and remained stable in the ward until discharge.

findings.title: Pharmacy bill date falls outside the hospital stay window
findings.detail: The pharmacy bill is dated prior to the admission date.
